# Ed Chapman — edwardchapman.co.uk

> Personal site of Ed Chapman, a senior full-stack engineer in London, UK.
> Python/Django + FastAPI backend, React/TypeScript frontend, AWS/Terraform
> infrastructure. Nine-plus years across proptech (commercial real estate
> financial modelling), supply-chain & logistics, and energy platforms, most
> recently as a senior/lead engineer. Treats AI/LLM tooling as real
> engineering — evaluated with eval harnesses (LLM-as-judge in CI), not vibed.

## Pages

- [Home](https://edwardchapman.co.uk/): profile, current projects, how I work, contact
- [Colophon](https://edwardchapman.co.uk/colophon/): how this site is built

## Projects

- [Foreman](https://github.com/edjchapman/Foreman): event-driven job-processing
  platform (Django, Celery, Channels, Redis, PostgreSQL, React/TS) —
  transactional outbox, worker retries, dead-letter handling, realtime progress.
- [AI Due Diligence Assistant](https://github.com/edjchapman/AI-Due-Diligence-Assistant):
  production-shaped LLM system (TypeScript, Fastify, LangGraph.js, pgvector,
  Claude) with an LLM-as-judge eval harness as a CI quality gate.
- [claude-code-config](https://github.com/edjchapman/claude-code-config):
  agentic-AI repo bootstrap kit (Claude Code plugin, MCP servers, GitHub
  Actions, validation hooks).
